documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a strong financial performance for the fiscal year 2025-26, achieving operating income of Rs. 1,58,563.68 lakhs and a robust EBITDA margin of 29%. Management highlighted significant technological advancements, including the installation of Tamil Nadu's first AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system and advancements in robotic-assisted surgeries and ECMO care. Additionally, the board approved the construction of a 300-bed paediatric hospital at the main center premises, with work expected to commence during the second quarter of 2026. The company remains committed to clinical excellence, affordable healthcare expansion, and maintaining a strong financial position.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that global healthcare demand is continuing to rise due to aging populations, rapid medical technology advancements, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: The medical college experienced significant growth with high demand for admission resulting in all seats being filled.
demand_outlook.quote: The Medical College has experienced significant growth over the past years, with a substantial increase in patient intake. Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed paediatric hospital at the main center premises.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital is adding another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The OP block for the Chennai hospital will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch have added cath lab and MRI facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated plans for an upcoming neurosciences center equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is focused on expanding the Department of Oncology.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operates a 5.25 MW solar power plant and expanded capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with this concept, your company operates a 5.25 MW solar power generation plant and purchases wind-generated power, covering nearly 68% of the annual power requirement. This practice has enabled your company to save approximately 31% on the annual power bill. Additionally, the company has expanded its capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to 5239.02 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital achieved an EBITDA margin of 29% for the financial year.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved a profit margin of 15% for the year 2024-25.
Solar and wind power generation covered nearly 68% of annual power requirements and enabled approximately 31% savings on annual power bills.
margins_costs.quote: In line with this concept, your company operates a 5.25 MW solar power generation plant and purchases wind-generated power, covering nearly 68% of the annual power requirement. This practice has enabled your company to save approximately 31% on the annual power bill.

margins_costs.claim: Production of biogas for captive consumption in the hospital canteen resulted in reduced LPG costs.
margins_costs.quote: Through this system, biodegradable food waste are decomposed, and biogas is produced for captive consumption in the hospital canteen. This initiative not only effectively manages waste but also results in reduced LPG costs, contributing to both environmental sustainability and cost savings.

orders_capacity.claim: The hospital operates as a 2000 bed facility.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors recommended a dividend of 15 per share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a 100% dividend for the financial year.
The recommended dividend of 10 rupees per share for FY 2024-25 involves a cash outflow of 1,094.23 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of ₹ 1,094.23 lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has neither provided nor were there any outstanding loans or guarantees covered under Section 186.
capital_allocation.quote: As on March 31, 2024, the Company has neither provided nor there were any outstanding loans or guarantees covered under the provisions of Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not accepted any deposits from the public or its members during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: As per Section 73 of the Companies Act 2013 read with the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits), Rules 2014, the company has not accepted any deposits from the public or its members during the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges like stringent regulatory compliance, advanced technology integration, and uninterrupted operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Substantial investments required to attract and retain qualified medical professionals have put pressure on cash flow.
risks_headwinds.quote: Significant investments are required to attract and retain qualified medical professionals, technicians, and skilled medical staff which has put pressure on our cash flow.

risks_headwinds.claim: The shortage of skilled medical professionals impacts institutions like KMCH and their ability to deliver quality care effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: The shortage of skilled medical professionals is a pressing issue in the healthcare industry, impacting institutions like KMCH and their ability to deliver quality care effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Regulatory requirements present significant challenges including compliance costs, administrative burdens, and lengthy approval processes.
risks_headwinds.quote: Regulatory requirements present significant challenges to the healthcare industry. Compliance costs, administrative burdens, lengthy approval processes, and potential legal consequences for non-compliance all work as a deterrent to the organization, demanding substantial investments of time and money to meet the legal requirements.

management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.
